features.name: Docking and detached windows
features.notes: Dock tabs, detach windows and save named layouts.

features.name: Multiple viewports
features.notes: Up to 16 independent cameras; Sandbox preview rendering.

features.name: Search and navigation
features.notes: Ctrl+P, menu filters, properties, graph navigation and asset queries.

features.name: Language and themes
features.notes: English by default, selectable French and six palettes.

features.name: Level / map editor
features.notes: Scene documents, selection, folders, locks and Undo; no game map codec.

features.name: Transform tools
features.notes: Move, rotate, scale, local/world and snapping; group translation only.

features.name: Automatic properties
features.notes: Adapter schemas generate fields; unknown game memory is not reflected.

features.name: Engine viewport rendering
features.notes: The game adapter must provide rendering, picking and engine integration.

features.name: Content Browser
features.notes: Folders, queries, type filters, favorites, tiles/list and file actions.

features.name: Asset references and Trash
features.notes: Declared graph dependencies, consumers and safe file restore.

features.name: Graph asset editors
features.notes: Independent document tabs and local function subgraphs.

features.name: Image / texture viewer
features.notes: PNG/JPEG/BMP channels, zoom and pan; no pixel painting or game texture codec.

features.name: JSON documents
features.notes: JSON tree editing, add/remove, Undo and guarded saves; 512 KiB / four open documents.

features.name: Import / reimport and thumbnails
features.notes: PNG/JPEG/BMP copy and bounded GLB/CyPack conversion; source hashes, protected reimport and image thumbnails.

features.name: Static mesh editor
features.notes: DX11 geometry and vertex tools, bounded static LOD generation and collision shapes; no production topology or physics cooking.

features.name: Skeleton and animation editors
features.notes: Hierarchy, skinning, clips/keys and reference-pose retarget baking; no IK or automatic humanoid rig solver.

features.name: Portable cross-SDK assets
features.notes: Native .cy3d editing with GLB/CyPack import/export and portable UUID preservation; game codecs require providers.

features.name: Logic node authoring
features.notes: Typed wires, variables, local functions, clipboard and comment groups.

features.name: Graph debugger
features.notes: Breakpoints, call stack, watches, step over/into/out and diagnostics.

features.name: Material authoring
features.notes: Procedural and image nodes, instances and compiled DX11 sphere/plane previews.

features.name: Complete Blueprint feature set
features.notes: Classes, methods, containers, macros, loops, events and delays now work; full engine semantics and Unreal compatibility remain work.

features.name: Material texture sampling
features.notes: PNG/JPEG/BMP CPU and DX11 sampling, sRGB, bilinear repeat and eight texture bindings; preview shaders only.

features.name: Editor plugins
features.notes: Trusted source plugin lifecycle and editor registry; no dynamic DLL loader.

features.name: Build and package
features.notes: Sandbox exports a document ZIP. A real game compiler requires a provider.

features.name: Play in editor
features.notes: No game runtime bridge is installed.

features.name: Native AI access
features.notes: Existing CyToolsCore MCP/SDK, shared dispatcher and official worker jobs.

features.name: Source control and profiling
features.notes: No Git/Perforce UI, engine profiler, landscape or cinematic editor.

features.name: Blueprint classes and containers
features.notes: Typed fields, inheritance, virtual methods, shared references and bounded array/map/set operations.

features.name: Inline macros and function loops
features.notes: Compile-time macro expansion and typed execution-function iteration with early break.

features.name: Graph events and simulation time
features.notes: Nonblocking delays, named events and explicit logical time; one execution lane, no engine event bridge.

features.name: Generated static LODs
features.notes: Protected boundary/seam clustering, real preview/export, stale-state detection and regeneration.

features.name: Collision shape authoring
features.notes: Conservative box/sphere/capsule fits, editable properties, wire preview and review markers.

features.name: Reference-pose retargeting
features.notes: Explicit bone mapping, target proportions, orientation correction and sampled clip baking.

features.name: Game codec providers
features.notes: Trusted executable registry, exact target/options, loss/hash/validation checks and Core jobs; no real game codec bundled.

features.name: Offline chain IK
features.notes: Fixed-root FABRIK clip baking, optional pole and reachable/error reporting. Unit scale; no joint limits or contacts.

features.name: Root motion extraction and reconstruction
features.notes: Original retained, in-place clip and rigid delta curve, sampled reconstruction and fingerprint guards. No engine movement binding.

features.name: Clip trimming and resampling
features.notes: New clip, selected range, zero-based time and bounded LINEAR sampling; original clip retained.

features.name: Named enums
features.notes: Local nominal types, validated members/defaults, literal/equality/string/switch nodes and function/variable support.

features.name: Named structures
features.notes: Bounded acyclic records, make/break/set nodes, recursive properties, class fields, signatures and clipboard transfer.

features.name: Class interfaces
features.notes: Local method contracts, typed native designer, matching class bindings, dynamic dispatch and shared debugger. No engine reflection or silent message fallback.

features.name: Signature migration
features.notes: Explicit preview/apply, port rename maps, linked function/interface closure, preserved values and Undo; losses require acceptance. Current graph only, no automatic asset-load migration.

features.name: Enum and structure migration
features.notes: Explicit field/member renames, nested defaults and typed values, reviewed resets/removals, hash-guarded apply and Undo. One owner only; referenced removed set-fields block.

features.name: Collapse selection to function or macro
features.notes: Preview and collapse a pure dependency region into a local function or macro, preserving nodes, fallback values, wire IDs and Undo. Execution, variable reads and non-uniform output dependencies reject.

features.name: Expand pure calls
features.notes: Hash-guarded preview and one Undo; typed reroutes, retained definitions and source-call provenance. Execution calls reject.
